reference: Fixed documented API contracts; expected arithmetic independently computed with Python arbitrary-precision integers, magnitude-based truncating division/shifts, integer bit_length, base-16 formatting and pow(base, exponent, modulus). No matching GNU CLI exists and no GNU parity is claimed.
coverage: Bash recognizes bignum as a builtin.
Bash help exposes the documented bignum synopsis.
signed arbitrary-precision decimal addition, subtraction and multiplication, including carry, borrow and zero normalization.
quotient and remainder signs, truncation toward zero and exact division.
hexadecimal input/output, case normalization and leading-zero handling.
modular remainder and modular exponentiation, including zero exponent and invalid modulus/exponent cases.
signed comparison output/status and bit lengths at zero and limb boundaries.
left/right shifts, including negative operands and counts crossing a 32-bit limb.
invalid numbers, missing/extra arguments, zero divisors and invalid shift counts.
exclusions: No exact matching GNU CLI; these are independently calculated operation contracts.
Very large/stress inputs, allocation-failure injection and constant-time cryptographic behavior are not qualified.

cases.purpose: Check through Bash's type builtin that bignum is registered as a shell builtin.
Check help availability and that its synopsis contains the documented command and complete subcommand set; print a stable marker after the assertions.
cases.script:
help_text=$(help -s bignum); case $help_text in *'bignum add|sub|mul|divmod|mod|modexp|cmp|bits|shl|shr [-x] ARGS...'*) printf 'documented synopsis available
' ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac

cases.purpose: Signed addition, subtraction, multiplication, carry/borrow and canonical zero beyond 64 bits.
Division truncates toward zero; remainder retains the dividend sign, including exact division.
cases.script:
bignum divmod -100 9
bignum divmod 100 -9
bignum divmod -100 -9
bignum divmod -99 9

cases.purpose: Hexadecimal parsing and lowercase magnitude output, prefixes, negative values and canonical zero.
cases.script:
bignum add -x 0Xff 1
bignum mul -x -0x10 0a
bignum add -x 0000 -0
bignum add -x 00000000ffffffff 1

cases.purpose: Dividend-sign remainder and independent Python pow results including exponent zero and modulus one.
cases.script:
bignum mod -100 9
bignum modexp 1234 567 891
bignum modexp 4 0 7
bignum modexp 4 0 1

cases.purpose: Three-way comparison output/status and bit lengths at zero, negative input and a limb boundary.
cases.script:
for pair in "-4 0" "17 17" "0 -1"; do read -r a b <<< "$pair"; if bignum cmp "$a" "$b"; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi; printf "status=%s\n" "$rc"; done
bignum bits 0
bignum bits -1024
bignum bits 4294967296

cases.purpose: Signed magnitude shifts, cross-limb counts, zero counts and counts larger than the magnitude bit length.
cases.script:
bignum shl 3 33
bignum shr 9 2
bignum shr -9 1
bignum shl 0 32
bignum shl -17 0
bignum shr -17 100

cases.purpose: Malformed numbers, missing/extra operands, zero divisors/modulus, negative exponent and invalid shift counts retain explicit API statuses and visible diagnostics.
cases.script:
if bignum add bad 1; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum add 1; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum add 1 2 3; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum divmod 2 0; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum mod 2 0; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum modexp 2 -1 5; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum modexp 2 2 0; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum shl 1 -1; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum shr 1 1x; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
if bignum add -x +1 1; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf "%s\n" "$rc"
